|accepted='''accepted'''. An editor will write it into [[{{SUBJECTPAGENAME}}]] and change the status to ''applied''.
|applied='''applied''' to [[{{SUBJECTPAGENAME}}]]{{#if:{{{revision|}}}|&#32;([[Special:Diff/{{{revision}}}|the change]])}}.
|declined='''declined'''. The discussion stays here for the record.

An associate editor decides when the discussion has settled, with the buttons ''Accept'' or ''Decline'' (shown to editors); without the buttons, change <code>status=open</code> in the first line of this topic and sign a reply.
}}{{#if:{{{paragraph|}}}|<div class="proposal-meta">One paragraph or figure of the page (<code>{{{paragraph}}}</code>), proposed with the edit button of the edition.</div>}}{{#if:{{{request|}}}|<div class="proposal-meta">A change asked for in words, with ''Propose a change'' in the edition: once it is accepted, an editor writes it into the page.</div>}}</div>{{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACE}}|{{ns:10}}||[[Category:{{#switch:{{lc:{{{status|open}}}}}|accepted=Accepted|applied=Applied|declined=Declined|#default=Open}} proposals]]}}<noinclude>
The box at the top of a proposal on a talk page. Parameters: ''status'' (open, accepted, applied or declined; default open); ''paragraph'' (the id of the paragraph, for a proposal made with the edit button of the edition); ''request'' (yes, for a change asked for in words with ''Propose a change'' in the edition); ''revision'' (once applied: the revision of the page that applied it). The box puts the talk page in the category of its status: [[:Category:Open proposals]], [[:Category:Accepted proposals]], [[:Category:Applied proposals]], [[:Category:Declined proposals]]. A new proposal starts from [[Template:Proposal/Preload-popup]] (the pop-ups of the edition: one paragraph, or a change asked for in words; before 11 November 2026, [[Template:Proposal/Preload]]) or [[Template:Proposal/Preload-block]] (link ''new proposal'' under the title of a page in the wiki). See [[How to contribute#Proposing a change|How to contribute]].</noinclude>
